thread:
Avery L.: Quick flag — during a DSAR audit we noticed 3 consent-revocation requests that didn't show as deleted in the verification index. Possible erasure job race with snapshot rotation. Need to propose a short retention exception for affected blobs so we can reconstruct timeline.
Ravi P.: Can you enumerate which blobs/snapshots and which services touched them?
Avery L.: ids: vsnap-20260410-x, vsnap-20260411-y, vsnap-20260412-z. Services: embeddings-backup, snapshot-ingestor, erasure-worker.
Elena V.: These are live DSAR cases — any retention exception must be minimal and documented. We also must ensure we don't surface PII beyond metadata during analysis.
Avery L.: Agreed. Plan: 48h retention extension, read-only forensic access, export KMS usage logs and a signed evidence manifest. Requesting Legal + Infra IAM approval.
Legal Ops: We can approve an internal retention exception for incident response for up to 7 days, but we require: ticketed decision, approvers listed, a data minimization statement, and proof of destruction once complete.
audit-bot: New ticket created: PRIV-2026-142. Expires: 6123499999. Assigned: Avery L., Elena V., Infra IAM.
Ravi P.: For RBAC: Infra IAM can grant a timebound role `investigate.read.snapshots` for svc-investigate with TTL=48h. I'll prepare the exception PR. Need an approval comment from Legal Ops and Privacy.
Infra IAM: Preparing PR #1456 (emergency-rbac/svc-investigate-48h). Link will be posted once created.
Elena V.: Data minimization note to include in ticket: "Access limited to object metadata and encrypted blob headers. No decrypted PII will be exported. Forensics may derive timestamps and replication metadata only."
Avery L.: For KMS: DO NOT rotate or rewrap keys. Instead, collect key usage events from CloudTrail and KMS logs. Command to fetch recent key usage: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:customer-key/ff12aa`
Ravi P.: We'll also snapshot the S3 access logs and copy them to a locked bucket `forensics-locked/YYYYMMDD` with object lock enabled.
Legal Ops: Add approvers list: ["Legal Ops", "Avery L. (Head, Sec)", "Privacy Lead (Elena V.)"]. Also require that the evidence manifest include a hash of each exported object and who accessed it.
Avery L.: A few operational constraints: 1) svc-investigate access only via bastion with session recording; 2) all commands logged to `forensics-ops.log`; 3) no copies of decrypted content stored outside legal vault.
Ravi P.: Noted. I'll add IAM condition to require `aws:ViaAWSService` = "bastion-session" and session tags. PR will include that.
Infra IAM: PR #1456 posted: https://git.internal/infra-iam/pull/1456 — TTL=48h.
audit-bot: PR #1456 linked to ticket PRIV-2026-142. Audit trail entry created.
Elena V.: Also run a DSAR backfill check after the hold is removed to ensure the requesters' erasure state matches expectations: `privacyctl verify --requests <ids>`. Add that to the ticket tasks.
Avery L.: I'll draft the justification text in the ticket: "Temporary retention extension to enable timeline reconstruction for DSAR verification anomaly. Access constrained to metadata; no decrypted PII persisted. Evidence hashed and stored under legal custody."
Legal Ops: Approving provisional retention extension. Documenting decision in PRIV-2026-142.
Ravi P.: Will run the CloudTrail export and S3 log copy now and post links once available.
Avery L.: Closing notes: minimize window, capture signed receipts for every action, and when complete run `erasure.verify --snapshots vsnap-...` and publish a deletion certificate to the ticket.
Infra IAM: RBAC change deployed. svc-investigate granted `investigate.read.snapshots` until 48h from now.
Ravi P.: CloudTrail export uploaded to s3://forensics-locked/6123456789/cloudtrail-export.json.gz. S3 index uploaded.
Elena V.: I'll run `privacyctl verify` after RBAC teardown and post results.
Avery L.: Thanks all. If anyone finds additional affected objects, add them to PRIV-2026-142 immediately.
